title: Zelensky urges unity, more money for Ukraine and sanctions on Russia ahead of key summit with EU leaders
lede: Ukrainian president Volodymyr Zelensky arrived in Brussels with two main requests for his meeting with EU leaders on Friday (16 October): more funds for Kyiv for defence and more sanctions against Russia.

title: How Slovakia’s Fico became Putin’s top ally inside the EU
lede: A Putin-friendly Slovakia aims to use its V4 presidency to push back against EU emissions-trading rules at this week's summit.
